buildings.label: Xưởng thiên văn

public apron joining platform to demonstration courtyard

buildings.label: Nhà sử liệu

buildings.label: Hiệu sách

buildings.function: Book browsing, reading discovery and future vocabulary hooks

buildings.label: Giấy & bút

buildings.label: Trà quán

buildings.label: Xưởng thủ công
buildings.facade: Three open work bays with tall east tool store; drying court distinct from sales frontage

buildings.label: Đình ven hồ

buildings.roofArrangement: Single compact hipped roof; south platform remains uncovered, lower than all halls
buildings.function: Quiet gathering and framed pond view; pavilion floor/collider to be art-reviewed later

buildings.label: Nhà sân U
buildings.facade: Small inward-looking U house, asymmetrical room lengths and recessed courtyard entry
buildings.roofArrangement: Three modest gables enclosing a small court, well below academy scale
buildings.function: Residential quiet court; no public route through private rooms

buildings.label: Nhà góc L
buildings.facade: Long horizontal house and east kitchen return, sheltered west garden entry
buildings.roofArrangement: Unequal L roof: broad hip/gable main roof and narrow lower kitchen roof
buildings.function: Residential family courtyard with working kitchen garden

buildings.label: Xưởng hội họa
buildings.facade: Long low studio, stepped east display gallery, west washing room; outdoor painting court
buildings.roofArrangement: Three different-height roof parts around an off-center art court; mostly horizontal display facade
buildings.function: Saimdang art / color / nature vocabulary, drying and painting discoveries

buildings.label: Nhà hai nếp
buildings.facade: Two offset small pavilions with a narrow covered connector; west shared garden entry
buildings.roofArrangement: Separated east-west ridges linked at one end; zigzag compound distinct from U and L houses
buildings.function: Garden residence and shared herb tending, not a shop

buildings.label: Nhà giếng chung
buildings.facade: Deep two-bay house with long low front porch and east shared-well apron
buildings.roofArrangement: One deep gable plus shallow veranda roof, no side-wing clone
buildings.function: Small dwelling with shared-well discovery off the lane

perspectiveContract.camera: orthographic top-down / light 3/4; no isometric tile diamonds
perspectiveContract.facades: principal facades east-west / south-facing; road bends do not rotate buildings
perspectiveContract.roofAxes: main ridge horizontal, short return wings perpendicular; no arbitrary 45 degree building rotation
perspectiveContract.doorReadability: plan doorway clearance64px; future visible door height88–96px against80px Juni; verify at camera1x before art approval
perspectiveContract.depth: separate roof/eave/front-wall/platform/trunk/canopy layers after approval; diagram is footprint/roof arrangement only

densityContract.rule: Functional plots and off-route discoveries, not uniform filler or blank traversal
densityContract.explorationRhythm: Target identifiable frontage, junction, courtyard or landscape change every roughly240–440px on primary discovery routes; measure below and refine after real gameplay.
densityContract.doNotClaim: Density and route distance are planning metrics, not a guarantee of fun or physical-device performance.
densityContract.budget: Use reused geometry/tiles and layered reusable props after approval; do not expand world to add empty time.
